title: Routes of Reasoning: Reading and Reshaping Test-Time Compute in MoE Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning models allocate test-time compute across distinct behaviors such as planning, deriving, and verifying. However, models frequently "overthink," continuing to verify and re-derive long after finding a correct answer. This wastes expensive compute and can even degrade performance. Existing interventions, such as token budgets or steering, primarily regulate reasoning duration rather than targeting specific behaviors. In this work, we demonstrate that Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers provide a natural, training-free interface for behavioral control. We first split reasoning traces into sentence-level segments and label each with one of six reasoning behaviors (planning, execution, restatement, fact, reflection, and conclusion), so that every token carries the behavior of its segment. Linear probes on router logits predict this label nearly as well as probes on the residual stream, the model's full hidden state and the standard targ

translated_title: 推理之路：读取与重塑MoE模型中的测试时计算
translated_abstract: 推理模型会将测试时计算分配给不同的行为，例如规划、推导和验证。然而，模型经常“过度思考”，在找到正确答案后很长时间仍继续验证和重新推导。这不仅浪费了昂贵的计算资源，甚至可能降低性能。现有的干预方法，如token预算或引导，主要调节推理时长，而非针对特定行为。在这项工作中，我们证明了混合专家模型的router提供了一种天然的、无需训练的行为控制接口。我们首先将推理轨迹切分为句子级片段，并用六种推理行为（规划、执行、复述、事实、反思和结论）之一对每个片段进行标注，使每个token都携带其所属片段的行为标签。作用于router logits上的线性探针预测该标签的效果，几乎与作用于残差流（即模型完整隐藏状态这一标准目标）上的探针相当。
tldr: 该论文发现MoE模型的router logits可以作为天然的、无需训练的行为控制接口，通过六类推理行为的标注与探针读取，实现对“过度思考”等特定推理行为的精准调控，从而节约测试时计算并提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that MoE router logits provide a natural, training-free interface for reading and reshaping test-time reasoning behaviors, enabling precise control over specific behaviors such as "overthinking" to save compute and improve performance.
